parameters.name: siteCode
parameters.description: The canonical Site code (the facility-layout Site code, e.g. WH1). It is both the plan lookup key AND the associate scope: activeHeads counts only assignments whose associate has an active (not-ended) shift at that site (ADR 0034, ADR 0035). The key is the resource identity and is used exactly as given (never trimmed); it is not required to be a canonical facility-layout code, because plans written under a legacy buildingId are read here too (ADR 0035). It is never validated against facility-layout: a key with no plan is 404.

parameters.name: shiftId
parameters.description: The shift (within the site) whose committed plan to read.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size, 1-500 (default 100). Empty or repeated is 400 invalid-limit.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque page token from the previous page's nextCursor; repeat the same filters. Undecodable or repeated is 400 invalid-cursor. Any other undeclared query parameter is 400 unknown-query-parameter.
